The '''Ruins of Zul'Mamwe''' is a [[troll]] ruin located south of the [[Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound]]. It is surrounded by mountains on all sides except north. The second major troll tribe of [[Stranglethorn Vale]], the [[Skullsplitter tribe|Skullsplitters]], inhabit Zul'Mamwe, led by their vicious chieftain, [[Ana'thek the Cruel]].
